bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; establishing a county and Tribe housing support administrative rate; requiring reports; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 12.

County and Tribe supplementary administrative rate.

(a) Notwithstanding subdivision 1 or any other law capping housing support payments to counties or Tribes, the commissioner of human services must determine a rate to be paid to counties and Tribes on top of any rates paid pursuant to this chapter based on the total yearly housing support payments to fund the following activities:

(1) establishing and maintaining housing support agreements with providers, including the establishment of contracting processes;

(2) overseeing and monitoring the quality of provider services; and

(3) determining eligibility and making payments to eligible providers.

(b) No later than February 27, 2026, the commissioner of human services must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over human services and housing on the rate established pursuant to this subdivision and the rate's methodology. If the commissioner of human services modifies the rate under this subdivision, the commissioner must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over human services and housing on the new rate and the rate's methodology by February 27 the following year.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; HOUSING SUPPORT ADMINISTRATIVE RATE.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for the county and Tribe housing support administrative rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 256I.05, subdivision 12.
